displayName: 法修·史丹比特 Vash the Stampede
description: Unofficial fan-art Vash the Stampede companion inspired by TRIGUN STAMPEDE (2023). Independently drawn compact animation with a paper doughnut and bag, a sealed water flask offer, open-palmed sidesteps and coat straightening, and original travel-running and low-jump cycles. The turquoise left mechanical arm is retained; safe props and choreography are original adaptations. No official affiliation.
author: Cozy Critters Studio
